test_stimuli.name: init_and_frame_output
test_stimuli.derivation: No read-back; init writes all commands, then output_frame_call writes column/page address commands and frame data. frame_ok sentinel ensures no error.

test_stimuli.name: frame_output_with_data
test_stimuli.derivation: output_frame_call writes column address range (0x21, 0x00, 0x7F), page address range (0x22, 0x00, 0x07), then 1024 bytes of frame data. frame_ok sentinel ensures no error.
